book.name: Talfut Kese
book.title: Sunbin-Got em Abiil so Kawin so Talfut Kelewse Sang te.

content: Ok Dang Fole Fole Fian Kese em Sang te.
Kaneko, iti deiw mak kelei, Yawe e Noa elo weng makso bokolewomele: “Ku nem kiin dim e ken kukuw kuw gelewbelew kunum te. Kasike, ku kukalem aul waneng ilo kuluko, siw tem da koyemolewka!

Samal mesesem ikal mak kuluko, siw tem dalolewka! Samal mali mak nem kiin dim e tokotoko so kebiliw samal bi imkel kuw amen amen kuluko, imok ben kel so yanggus ben kel so yemkal yemkal ben kel mak siw tem elo da koyemolewka! Kate, mali samal nem kiin dim e ninik so kebiliw samal bikati imikel kuw amen amen kuluko, imok e, yanggus e, yemkal yemkal makmak kuw kulolewka!
Abiil em awon bakati ben kel imok e, ben kel yanggus e, yemkal yemkal ben kel kulolewka! “Mesik esik kawin dim kaleem samal alik alik biim mongom e atin kuw banimokoliw kai!” angomi, kelolewka!

Nimtew angom? Ben kel ding banimi, ne suuk fian mak mit dabalaloki kasike. Taw ding akati, mililiw ding akati, akalka fo akalka fo ding tulun kuw kelokobe be, fu alew ding keloke te. Keko beli, kawin dim kaleem mesesem mesesem finik so biliw bi atin atin kuiaw yen banim keyemokite.”, dangse kale.
Dangeko, Noa e Yawe em dangse weng be kiliko, fein gelewse kale.
Ok dang ok fole fole kelewse beem talse ding e Noa em itol e 600 kese kale.
Kelei, Noa so, akalem aul waneng biso, alik alik i siw tem elo unsiliw kasike, ok dang ok fole fole kelewse be ilo yeninba kese kale.
Keko beli, awon so, samal mesesem so, mali Sunbin-Got em kiin dim tokotoko so kebiliw samal biso, mali Sunbin-Got em kiin dim ninik so kebiliw samal biso,
imok so, yanggus so, alik alik i ba teliwi, Noa e ilo siw tem da koyemse kale. Feinka! Kanelewse alik alik be Sunbin-Got em Noa elo dangse weng beelo ki kelewse kale.
Anfel e, ben kel ding uneko, banimei, ok dang ok fole fole keko, telesomi, kawin dim alik alik kasi kolewse kale.
Noa em itol e 600 keko, auk teben em kayow e, mali em guel ding kelei, abiil so kawin so kaloko, ok inkalso mak fuktem da telei, abiil dim emikal
suuk inkalso mak mitse kale. Suuk kuw man bom mene tak mene tak belei, mililiw banim taw banim, fu alew ding kese kale.
Suuk telse ding kabalak be, Noa so, em muluwel alemsal Sem o, Kam o, Yafet biso, ikalem kalel kumel biso, alik alik kunum waneng bi siw tem unsiliw kale.
Unsomeliwi, kut samal so, am samal so, samal teing yan banim so, awon so, mesesem mesesem bel aliw so, alik alik samal bi

Noa eso, siw tem unsiliw kale. Feinka, samal bi yemkal yemkal kuw keko, siw tem unsiliw kale. Feinka! I Sunbin-Got em Noa elo angse kitil weng beelo kilele gelewsiliw kale. Gelewsomeliwi, Sunbin-Got akalem ete siw em am yal aise kale.
Ailei, fu alew ding kesomelei, ok dang ok fole fole fian be fasuko, siw sel elo daolei, e kawin be koleweko, katiw unko,
Ok fole fole fasu kebe okmun beem dim kel danong danong angse kale.
Angeko, ok fian be siw beelo alik gulok gulok uneko, amgu fian sel dim alikum atin kuw kasi kolewse kale.
Kolewsomelei, ok be amgu tikin fian tiakim beelo atin kuw kasi kolewsomelei, katiw katiw uneko, ben kel em mita bakilewse kale.
Beem ding dim kabalak e, ok fole fole be am samal bi so, kut samal bi so, awon bi so, samal yan banim teing banim so, kawtiw so, alik alik finik so biliw biilo tom kuyaw kuyaw yese kale.
Feinka! Ok kut bomi, tiow kawin dim alakabiliw finik so bin eisneng alik alik i atin kuw kuansiliw kale.

Beli, Sunbin-Got e kunum waneng so, am samal so, kut samal so, abiil em awon so, samal yan banim teing banim so, alik alik finik so biliw eisneng biim mongom ete ok tomelei, alik alik ilo kuiaw kuiaw yenei, i kuansiliw kale. Kate, Noa so, akalem siw tem talsiliw samal iso, eso biliw kunum waneng biso, ite kuw kuaninba kesiliw kale.
Keko beli, ok dang ok fole fole be fian kuw keko, fasuko, belei, 150 ding kese kale.
